one_liner: Web data API for AI agents to search, scrape, and interact with the live web to get clean Markdown or structured data.
auth_notes: Requires an Authorization header containing a Bearer token (API key starting with fc-).
verdict_reason: Firecrawl provides a fully documented public REST API utilizing simple Bearer token authentication with self-serve signup.

evidence.quote: For authentication, it's required to include an Authorization header. The header should contain Bearer fc-123456789 , where fc-123456789 represents your API Key
Firecrawl is the web data API for AI agents. Search, scrape, and interact with the live web to get clean Markdown or structured data.
